question: Do fixed 2025 sites sample a different future loss distribution from suitable grids, and how large is the contrast relative to climate-pathway differences?
outputs: PNG only, 600 dpi; full figures and independent rows/panels

curves.weight: fixed 2025 capacity; suitable reference uses area

histograms.sample: one grid, ten-year mean within each model, then four-model mean
histograms.weight: equal grid counts divided by group grid count; relative frequency, not density
histograms.bins: same width and limits across SSPs within each technology; retain signed losses and full tails

validation: fixed IDs and capacities across climate paths/models
four models and ten years per grid
future layout matrix audited separately from installed-versus-suitable contrast
